g.text: One registry, many regions and components: one view
How Transactions and Data Transfer stay whole: each registry lands on one shard, and registries are spread across shards
by the component that handled it
Each registry stays on one shard,
Before: every registry's metrics went to one account with one finite budget.
Signals this large would eventually exhaust it, so sharding had to come first.
Shards are labeled with symbols and names; color is not needed to read the diagram.
not by the region that served it
